decisions_made.decision: docs/SOLUTION.md is the binding specification; code follows it and deviations require an approved doc edit first
decisions_made.rationale: Owner's standing instruction. A .docx cannot be diffed or reviewed, so the contract moved to version-controlled Markdown (ADR-09). The .docx is frozen unmodified.

decisions_made.decision: MBTA is the development substrate; Delhi is the deployment target (ADR-08)
decisions_made.rationale: Delhi OTD publishes no occupancy and crowd labels are the product. City knowledge is confined to adapters/ and config/cities/ so the swap is configuration.

decisions_made.decision: Section 31 restructured from a strict P0-P7 march into vertical slices
decisions_made.rationale: Owner wants a working frontend with live features and a deployment. A bottom-up order leaves nothing visible or deployable until most of the work is done.

decisions_made.decision: Deploy to a single VM running the existing Compose stack (section 14.4)
decisions_made.rationale: Keeps section 27 unchanged. TimescaleDB is unavailable on most managed free tiers, so a split Vercel/Render deployment would have forced a schema rewrite.
A credible basemap with no API key that also works with networking disabled, so the offline demo requirement in section 19 / F.4 survives.

decisions_made.decision: Stop gate corrected from 10,297 to 9,630 stops with geometry
decisions_made.rationale: 667 rows are coordinate-less location_type=3 pathway nodes that no trip references, and section 27 declares stop.geom NOT NULL. Both could not hold.

decisions_made.decision: Malformed rows are skipped and counted; conversion fails above 0.1%
decisions_made.rationale: A live append-only CSV always ends mid-write, so strict failure is unusable; silent skipping would let a broken capture report success.

decisions_made.decision: GitHub repo is private, and commit messages carry no AI co-author trailer
decisions_made.rationale: Owner's explicit instruction. Private keeps the internal deck, architecture document and SIH submission PDF unpublished before judging.

errors_encountered.error: Three record_feed.py processes were appending to the same CSVs concurrently, multiply-recording every observation and interleaving mid-row into torn lines
errors_encountered.resolution: Stopped PIDs 52120 and 66296 with the owner's approval; kept PID 39404 so recording never paused. Data recorded after 09:00 on 2026-08-30 is single-sourced.

errors_encountered.error: An unrelated postgres:16 container already owned host port 5432. Docker silently declines to publish a taken port, so the stack looked healthy while every client reached the other database and failed authentication
errors_encountered.resolution: Published the database on host port 15432 instead. Diagnosed by correlating a failed connection against our container's logs, which showed nothing.

errors_encountered.error: Torn CSV rows do not always have the wrong column count; one landed with 18 commas but an ingest_ts of ':46.962563', producing a partition directory of that name
errors_encountered.resolution: Added _drop_unusable_timestamps requiring an ISO-8601 prefix, counted under the same malformed-row policy.

errors_encountered.error: Row accounting was off by exactly 8: pyarrow's schema-sniffing pass invoked the counting handler before the real pass ran
errors_encountered.resolution: The sniffing pass now uses a non-counting handler. Caught only because the corpus test asserts the three outcomes partition the input exactly.

errors_encountered.error: Several commands reported exit code 0 while tests failed or skipped, because piping to tail masks pytest's status
errors_encountered.resolution: Results are read from the pytest summary line, never the exit code. Recorded in .context/dead_ends.md.

errors_encountered.error: A PowerShell here-string used inside the Bash tool corrupted the first commit message; large bash heredocs silently failed to parse and wrote nothing
errors_encountered.resolution: Amended the commit. File writes now use the editor tool rather than shell heredocs.
